coverage_notes: The paper does not specify a separate biological encoder, connector module, vocabulary-extension procedure, exact prompt serialization beyond text-formatted biological values, or the source/model used to generate automatic reasoning traces. It also does not report a biological-input removal, corruption, or no-biology baseline experiment.

evidence.quote: Classification tasks were evaluated by accuracy (proportion of correct predictions).

The most pronounced advantage was observed in RNA-based cancer prognosis, where the SFT model achieved 0.77 accuracy on TCGA pairwise progression-free survival comparisons (which patient lived longer without progression?).

To place Longevity-LLM in the context of current commercial systems, we evaluated it against 15 frontier LLMs across seven Longevity Bench tasks spanning tasks in the domains of oncology prognosis,  age  and  mortality  prediction.

It  is  especially  notable  that  LongevityLLM  features  no  architectural  augmentations  for  DNAm  data  processing,  such  as  dedicated  prediction  heads,  special  tokens,  or  separate  treatment  of  numeric  values.

representation_rationale.summary: The authors present use of the unmodified text-transformer architecture for DNAm processing as a benefit.

evidence.quote: The resulting system, Longevity-LLM v0.1, operates within a single 14-billion-parameter Qwen3 model and can process methylation, proteomic, transcriptomic, and clinical data without external dependencies.

representation_rationale.summary: A single language model can process several biological modalities without external dependencies.

evidence.quote: However, much like genomic foundation models, they use custom architectures, tokenizers, and data  preprocessing  steps,  which  prevent  their  integration  in  the  wider  AI  infrastructure.

representation_rationale.summary: The authors criticize custom omics architectures, tokenizers, and preprocessing because they hinder integration with broader AI infrastructure.

evidence.quote: Our  decision  to  build  a  monolithic  aging  model  rather  than  a  tool-based  agent  system  was  motivated by the goal of developing an internally consistent representation of molecular aging

representation_rationale.summary: The monolithic design was chosen to develop an internally consistent representation of molecular aging.
